patches.reason: Legacy bug (creator report): getImgTest() gives "reset" when it finds no card in 100 draws, and the main loop then empties the list of completed cards and draws again; with no category activated (all fapioh.catX false or never set) the second draw gives "reset" too, the image "fapiohreset" does not exist, and ">>>" took the card name with substring(indexOf('-') - 1), which failed at -2 (V2 explorer: TSR025 at fapioh/fapioh.tease:351). Evident intent: draw a card of the activated categories; with none, there is nothing to play, so the game says so and ends as its Exit does.
